description: Six-panel summary: AP-64 charge percentile within 1451 UniProt AMPs, descriptor percentiles, bipartite charge/hydrophobicity architecture, helical-wheel face charge, and Eisenberg/charge discriminant plots
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math, requests
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9,"axes.spines.top":False,"axes.spines.right":False})
AMP=pd.read_csv("uniprot_amp_reference_set.csv")
D=pd.read_csv("ap64_descriptor_table.csv")
FACE=pd.read_csv("amphipathic_face_charge.csv")
AP64="DDKPDKPDDKPDDSGKDPKPDFPKFLSLLGTEIIENAVEFILRSMSRSTGFMEFDDNEGKHSSK"
EISEN={'A':0.62,'R':-2.53,'N':-0.78,'D':-0.90,'C':0.29,'Q':-0.85,'E':-0.74,'G':0.48,'H':-0.40,
       'I':1.38,'L':1.06,'K':-1.50,'M':0.64,'F':1.19,'P':0.12,'S':-0.18,'T':-0.05,'W':0.81,'Y':0.26,'V':1.08}
CH={'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.1,'D':-1,'E':-1}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,9.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,3,hspace=0.55,wspace=0.32)

# A: net charge distribution of 1451 UniProt AMPs
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
ax.hist(AMP.net_q,bins=60,color="#9aa6b2",edgecolor="white",linewidth=.3)
ax.axvline(-6.10,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
ax.text(-6.4,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.82,"AP-64\n(-6.1, 1.5th pct)",ha="right",color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
for nm,v,c in [("LL-37",5.86,"#2471a3"),("magainin-2",2.90,"#2471a3"),("cecropin-A",5.86,"#2471a3"),("Bac7",10.86,"#117a65")]:
    ax.axvline(v,color=c,lw=1,ls="--")
ax.text(10.9,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.6,"Bac7 (+10.9)",color="#117a65",fontsize=8)
ax.text(5.9,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.45,"LL-37 / cecropin-A (+5.9)",color="#2471a3",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_ylabel("number of peptides")
ax.set_title("A  AP-64 vs 1,451 annotated mature AMPs (UniProt, reviewed, KW-0929)",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

# B: percentile summary
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
labs=["net charge","charge\ndensity","max hydrophobic\nmoment (w=18)"]; vals=[1.5,3.5,90.9]
cols=["#c0392b","#c0392b","#1e8449"]
ax.barh(labs,vals,color=cols); ax.axvline(50,color="k",lw=.6,ls=":")
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(v+2,i,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,110); ax.set_xlabel("percentile within AMP reference set")
ax.set_title("B  Descriptor percentiles",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

# C: charge / hydrophobicity along AP-64
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:2])
w=9; pos=np.arange(1,len(AP64)+1)
locq=np.array([sum(CH.get(r,0) for r in AP64[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(len(AP64))])
loch=np.array([np.mean([EISEN[r] for r in AP64[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]]) for i in range(len(AP64))])
ax.fill_between(pos,0,locq,where=locq>=0,color="#2471a3",alpha=.65,label="local net charge (9-res window)")
ax.fill_between(pos,0,locq,where=locq<0,color="#c0392b",alpha=.65)
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(pos,loch,color="#196f3d",lw=1.6,label="Eisenberg hydrophobicity"); ax2.spines.top.set_visible(False)
ax.axvspan(1,22,color="#c0392b",alpha=.07); ax.axvspan(30,47,color="#196f3d",alpha=.10)
ax.text(11,4.2,"acidic Pro-rich\ndisordered N-half\n(net -4.1, 23% Pro)",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#7b241c")
ax.text(38.5,4.2,"amphipathic helix\nGTEIIENAVEFILRSMSR\n(uH 0.60, AF pLDDT 75)",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#145a32")
ax.set_xlabel("residue in mature AP-64 (precursor 24-87)"); ax.set_ylabel("local net charge"); ax2.set_ylabel("mean hydrophobicity")
ax.set_ylim(-5.5,5.5); ax.set_title("C  AP-64 is bipartite: acidic disordered N-half + hydrophobic amphipathic C-half",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

# D: polar-face charge
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
f=FACE.copy(); short=[p.split(" best")[0].split(" (")[0] for p in f.peptide]
cc=["#c0392b" if v<0.5 else "#2471a3" for v in f.polar_face_charge]
ax.barh(short,f.polar_face_charge,color=cc); ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.7)
ax.set_xlabel("charge on polar (membrane-contacting) face")
ax.set_title("D  Helical-wheel face charge",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

# E: Eisenberg uH vs H plot
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
ax.scatter(AMP.meanH,AMP.uH18,s=4,color="#c8d0d8",label="UniProt AMPs (n=1451)")
pts={"AP-64":(-0.219,0.602,"#c0392b"),"LL-37":(-0.306,0.894,"#2471a3"),"magainin-2":(0.173,0.506,"#2471a3"),
     "cecropin-A":(0.037,0.658,"#2471a3"),"DCD-1L":(0.065,0.564,"#e67e22"),"Bac7":(-0.489,0.569,"#117a65"),
     "PR-39":(-0.329,0.379,"#117a65")}
for k,(x,y,c) in pts.items():
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=55,color=c,edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5,zorder=3); ax.annotate(k,(x,y),(4,4),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity <H>"); ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment uH")
ax.set_title("E  Eisenberg amphipathicity plot",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

# F: charge vs uH, the discriminating plane
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1:])
ax.scatter(AMP.net_q,AMP.uH18,s=4,color="#c8d0d8")
p2={"AP-64":(-6.10,0.602,"#c0392b"),"LL-37":(5.86,0.894,"#2471a3"),"magainin-2":(2.90,0.506,"#2471a3"),
    "cecropin-A":(5.86,0.658,"#2471a3"),"histatin-3":(5.12,0.251,"#8e44ad"),"DCD-1L":(-2.10,0.564,"#e67e22"),
    "Bac7":(10.86,0.569,"#117a65"),"PR-39":(9.86,0.379,"#117a65")}
for k,(x,y,c) in p2.items():
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=60,color=c,edgecolor="k",linewidth=.5,zorder=3); ax.annotate(k,(x,y),(5,4),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8,ls="--")
ax.text(-9.5,1.05,"anionic",fontsize=8,color="#c0392b"); ax.text(1,1.05,"cationic",fontsize=8,color="#2471a3")
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment uH")
ax.set_title("F  AP-64 is amphipathic but sits on the anionic side of the plane that separates\n    membrane-lytic host-defence peptides from the rest",loc="left",fontweight="bold")
plt.show()
